note: Non-authoritative projection of the source-controlled Volume 11 corpus. Confers no ratification and authorizes no implementation or operations.

operating_states.title: Defined
operating_states.exit: Implementation authorized under a future gate.
operating_states.distinction: A defined service is not an implemented service.

operating_states.title: Implemented
operating_states.distinction: An implemented service is not a verified service.

operating_states.title: Verified
operating_states.distinction: A verified service is not a release candidate.

operating_states.title: Release Candidate
operating_states.distinction: A release candidate is not an operationally prepared service.

operating_states.title: Operationally Prepared
operating_states.distinction: Operationally prepared is distinct from operationally accepted.

operating_states.title: Operationally Accepted
operating_states.distinction: Operationally accepted is distinct from deployed.

operating_states.title: Operating
operating_states.distinction: Operating is distinct from degraded and from suspended.

operating_states.title: Degraded
operating_states.exit: Recovery to operating or escalation to suspended.
operating_states.distinction: A degraded service is a controlled state, not an uncontrolled failure.

operating_states.title: Suspended
operating_states.distinction: A suspended service is deliberately controlled, not abandoned.

operating_states.title: Recovering
operating_states.distinction: Recovering is distinct from operating and from retired.

operating_states.title: Retired
operating_states.entry: Governed retirement decision with retained evidence.
operating_states.distinction: A retired service is a controlled terminal state with retained evidence.
